cards.text: When Revealed: The opposing team chooses a questing charactert controlled by each player and removes them from the quest.

cards.name: Orc Raiders
cards.text: Forced: After Orc Raider engages a player, deal it a shadow card.

cards.name: Silent Caverns
cards.text: While Silent Caverns is in the staging area, each player`s threat cannot be reduced by more than 1 each round.Travel: Raise each player`s threat by 2.

cards.name: Cave-troll
cards.text: Cannot have non-objective player card attachments.Allies cannot be declared as attackers or defenders against Cave-troll.

cards.name: Old Stone-troll
cards.text: Cannot have non-objective player card attachments.Forced: After Old Stone-troll attachs and destroys a character you control, raise your threat by 1 for each excess point of damage dealt.

cards.name: Hobgoblin
cards.text: Forced: After Hobgobling engages a player, it cannot take damage until the end of the round.

cards.name: Goblin Dungeon
cards.text: When Revealed: The opposing team chooses an ally, discards all tokens from it, and places it faceup as a guarded objective. When Goblin Dungeon is explored, return that ally to its owner`s control exhausted.

cards.name: Nearing the Gate
cards.text: When Revealed: Add the set-aside Durin`s Bane to the staging area. It cannot take damage this round. If there is more than 1 player, it makes an immediate attack against the first player.
cards.back_text: Each player`s threat cannot be reduced by player card effects.Durin`s Bane is considered to be engaged with each player and attacks each player in turn order during the combat phase. (Deal and resolve a shadow card for each attack.)If the players defeat this stage, they win the game.

cards.name: Nearing the Gate
cards.text: When Revealed: Add the set-aside Durin`s Bane to the staging area. It cannot take damage this round. If there is more than 1 player, it makes an immediate attack against the first player.
cards.back_text: No more than 5 progress can be placed here each round.Forced: At the beginning of the quest phase, Durin`s Bane makes an attack against the first player. Any undefended or excess damage dealt by this attack must be placed here.If this stage has damage on it equal to or greater than its quest points, the players lose the game. If this stage is defeated the players win the game.

cards.name: Black Uruks

cards.name: Chieftain of the Pit
cards.text: Cannot have non-objective player card attachments or take non-combat damage.Shadow effects cannot be canceled.Forced: When Chieftain of the Pit attacks, deal it an additional shadow card.

cards.name: Western Hall
cards.text: Travel: Discard the top card of the encounter deck. Raise each player`s threat by X, where X is that card`s printed [threat].

cards.name: Orcish Howls
cards.text: When Revealed: Exhaust X characters, where X is the number of Uruk enemies in play. If there are no Uruk enemies in play, Orcish Howls gains surge.

cards.name: Branching Paths
cards.text: Branching Paths gets +1 [threat] for each location in the staging area. (Limit +3 [threat].)

cards.name: Rock Adder
cards.text: Players cannot declare defenders against Rock Adder.

cards.name: Black Bats
cards.text: When Revealed: Eithe raise each player`s threat by 2, or reveal an additional encounter card.

cards.name: Cave Spider
cards.text: Forced: When Cave Spider attacks, either remove 2 progress from the main quest, or Cave Spider gets +2 [attack] for this attack.

cards.name: Swarm of Bats
cards.text: When Revealed: Each character gets -1 [willpower] until the end of the phase.

cards.name: Vast and Intricate
cards.text: When Revealed: The opposing team attaches Vast and Intricate to a non-unique location in the staging area. If there are no non-unique locations in the staging area, Vast and Intricate gains surge. (Counts as a Condition attachment with the text: `Attached location gets +2 [threat] and is immune to player card effects.`)

cards.name: Shadow Dweller
cards.text: Cannot have non-objective player card attachments or take non-combat damage.Forced: When Shadow Dweller attacks you, discard the top card of your deck and assign X damage among character you control, where X is the discarded card`s cost.

cards.name: Dreadful Gap
cards.text: While Dreadful Gap is in the staging area, progress cannot be placed on other locations in the staging area.Travel: The opposing team chooses a card in the encounter discard pile and shuffles it into the encounter deck.

cards.name: Forked Passage
cards.text: While Forked Passage is in the staging area, raise each player`s threat by 1 additional point during the refresh phase.Travel: Raise each player`s threat by 1.

cards.name: Chance Encounter
cards.text: When Revealed: The highest [attack] enemy in the staging area makes an attack against the first player. If no attack is made this way, Chance Encounter gains surge.

cards.name: Mithril Lode
cards.text: While Mitril Lode is the active location, it gains: `Response: When Mithril Lode is explored, each player adds 1 resource to the resource pool of a hero he controls.

cards.name: Out of the Depths
cards.text: Setup: Add Dark Pit to the staging area. The opposing team searches the encounter deck for one different 0-cost enemy or location per player and adds them to the staging area. Shuffle the encounter deck.
cards.back_text: Shuffle the encounter deck.Forced: When Dark Pit is explored, flip it over and set Durin`s Bane aside, out of play. Each player searches the top 5 cards of his deck for a card, adds it to his hand, and shuffles his deck.This stage cannot be defeated while Dark Pit is in play.

cards.name: Lightless Grotto
cards.text: While Lightless Grotto is in the staging area, non-unique enemies in the staging area cannot take damage.Travel: The first player chooses an enemy in the staging area and engages it.

cards.name: Nameless Thing
cards.text: Forced: After Nameless Thing enters play, the first player attaches the top card of his deck to it faceup as a guarded attached. Nameless Thing gets +X [threat], +X [attack], and +X [defense], where X is that card`s printed cost. When Nameless Thing leaves play, discard that card.

cards.name: Unspeakable Thing
cards.text: Forced: When Unspeakable Thing attacks you, discard the top card of your deck. Unspeakable thing gets +X [attack] for this attack, where X is the discarded card`s printed cost.

cards.name: Deep Fissure
cards.text: When Revealed: Each player deals 1 damage to a questing character he controls and removes that character from the quest.

cards.name: Deep Deep Dark
cards.text: When Revealed: Each player must choose: either raise your threat by 1 for each character you control, or discard a character you control.

cards.name: New Devilry
cards.text: When Revealed: Until the end of the round, treat each character`s text box as if it were blank, except for Traits.

cards.name: A Foe Beyond
cards.text: When Revealed: The opposing team chooses an attachment controlled by a player and discards it. If no attachment is discarded this way, A Foe Beyond gains surge.

cards.name: Many Roads
